integrity: Proof establishes all-parameter statements through derivative signs, quadratic threshold roots and a contraction argument. Finite numerical checks are corroboration only. February 26, 2024 is the source paper preprint public date, not the date when the unweighted journal revision appeared. Independent external validation has not been performed.
limitations: Unweighted affine least-squares fitting on a scalar integrator, exact endpoint matching, noiseless state and continuous equality-trigger detection only; no claims for the discounted fitting in original arXiv v1, nonlinear plants, higher-degree bases, sampled triggering or actuator limitations. The 2023 linear-systems ETPC predecessor has residual inaccessible-full-text originality risk.
title: A grazing discontinuity and unattained optimal fitting horizon in affine event-triggered control
